candidatos_directos.justificacion: La historia solicita visualizar la información básica y datos de contacto (número celular y correo electrónico) del usuario, lo cual empata directamente con la recuperación de datos de referencia (Reference) y contacto del Service Domain Party Reference Data Directory.
candidatos_directos.rol_bian: The party reference data directory service domain maintains a potentially wide range of party reference data that might be used in any interaction between the bank and the party including relationship development, sales/marketing, servicing and product delivery. This can include general reference and contact details, party associations, demographic details and some servicing preferences. Different information may be maintained for different party types such as individuals, corporates, partners

candidatos_descartados.justificacion: La historia busca visualizar datos personales y acceder a opciones de edición de contacto, lo cual no corresponde al manejo de órdenes de servicio genéricas que ofrece el Service Domain Servicing Order.
candidatos_descartados.rol_bian: The Servicing Order service domain handles the processing of a request that may impact multiple products and services and may involve processing cycles/steps and possibly have associated fees/charges. There can be several types of standard 'servicing order' defined for selection as appropriate. A servicing order can be initiated by a customer directly or may be requested on their behalf by an authorized third party service provider. If the request is made by a third party service provider on behalf of a customer the process can include a check that the associated permissions/mandates are in place
assumptions: La gestión de datos personales recae en un dominio dedicado a Party o Customer Profile.
gaps: No existe operación en Servicing Order para consultar directamente datos demográficos o de contacto de un cliente.

candidatos_descartados.justificacion: La historia trata sobre visualizar datos personales y acceder a la edición de celular y correo, mientras que Customer Access Entitlement administra acuerdos de perfil de acceso a canales y restricciones, sin gestionar datos personales ni de contacto.
candidatos_descartados.rol_bian: This profile is used for servicing and fulfillment controls covering products, services and channel/device usage entitlements. It is referenced for channel access control and utilization limits that may span multiple products. For example there can be a limit on total ATM withdrawals for a customer for all active products over a 24 hour period.
assumptions: La gestión de datos personales y de contacto pertenece a Party Directory o Party Profile.
gaps: El paquete no contiene operaciones para consultar o actualizar datos personales ni información de contacto del cliente.

candidatos_descartados.justificacion: The user story is about displaying and editing personal data, which is not an authentication operation. No operation or schema in the Party Authentication package matches the verb or object of the story. Therefore the story is not owned by this Service Domain.
candidatos_descartados.rol_bian: Customer/party authentication is a cross-channel/device capability that provides identity confirmation for customers accessing the bank through any interactive channel. The service may use a combination of one or more mechanisms to authenticate including issued tokens/devices, virtual mechanisms such as passwords and biometrics such as voice/face recognition. Different levels of authentication may be determined to support different types of access and there may be access permissions associated with the authentication mechanism used
